Quantum Information-Theoretic Analysis of Optical Fiber Sensing via Stimulated Brillouin Scattering
item.description: arXiv:2610.12980v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Stimulated Brillouin scattering (SBS) is a powerful mechanism for distributed sensing in optical fibers, as the Brillouin response is highly sensitive to local material parameters. Assuming the input probe is a quantum state, we develop a quantum-information-theoretic framework for SBS-based fiber sensing and intrusion detection. item.description: 2026年7月10日，国际电信联盟国际海缆韧性咨询机构首届任期收官会议在瑞士日内瓦召开。该机构是国际电信联盟推动全球海缆治理体系建设的重要机制，下设海缆快速部署与维修风险监测与缓解地理路由多样性三个工作组，旨在凝聚各界力量，研究海缆建设与保护中的重大问题，推动形成国际共识和政策建议。
